method: Sequential GNU time -v runs use the same 123-rule argv, default eight workers, four-million retained syntax nodes, and 128 MiB derived-text cache. TIMINGS/CACHE_STATS enabled; JOBS/AST_CACHE_NODES/MALLOC_ARENA_MAX unset. Baseline executable archived before editing. Findings are sorted unique complete tagged physical lines joined by LF without a trailing LF; no other normalization. Host activity and Rayon scheduling are uncontrolled. Validation gates ran afterward, concurrently with each other, outside the measured pair.
